basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (PM SHRI JNV Bolangir) TGT Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website. A total of 5 TGT vacancies have been announced through the PM SHRI JNV Bolangir TGT Recruitment 2026 for TGT (Computer Science), TGT (Science), TGT (Hindi), and TGT (Music) posts.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc. or B.E. or B.Tech. (Computer Science/IT) with 50% marks, Four years integrated degree course from NCTE with B.Ed. component OR Bachelor Degree with B.Ed. OR B.Ed.-M.Ed. OR Post-Graduation with B.Ed.-M.Ed. (50% marks), Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts with 50% marks
qualification.details: TGT (Computer Science): Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc. or B.E. or B.Tech. (Computer Science/IT) from a recognized university/institute with at least 50% marks & above. TGT (Science): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component OR Bachelor/Honours Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in concerned subject AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks OR other equivalent as per notification. TGT (Hindi): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component OR Bachelor/Honours Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in concerned subject AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks OR other equivalent as per notification. TGT (Music): Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject and also in aggregate, provided that Music subject is studied in all the years of degree as a main subject.

salary_details.details: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 34125 Per Month.

PM SHRI JNV Bolangir TGT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: TGT (Computer Science): Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc. or B.E. or B.Tech. (Computer Science/IT) from a recognized university/institute with at least 50% marks & above. TGT (Science): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component OR Bachelor/Honours Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in concerned subject AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks OR other equivalent as per notification. TGT (Hindi): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component OR Bachelor/Honours Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in concerned subject AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks OR other equivalent as per notification. TGT (Music): Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject and also in aggregate, provided that Music subject is studied in all the years of degree as a main subject.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI JNV Bolangir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 30 July 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well before the reporting time to complete the registration process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced for the TGT posts?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies have been announced for the TGT posts, including TGT (Computer Science), TGT (Science), TGT (Hindi), and TGT (Music).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the TGT posts at PM SHRI JNV Bolangir?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all TGT posts is 50 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the TGT recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the TGT posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 34125 per month for the contractual TGT positions.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for TGT (Computer Science)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc. or B.E. or B.Tech. (Computer Science/IT) with at least 50% marks from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these TGT positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for PM SHRI JNV Bolangir Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Belpada, Bolangir, Odisha, 767026.

faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
